name: overhead_cpu_cores_5s
query: sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="POD", container!="", namespace=~"open5gs|monarch", pod=~".*(amf|smf|upf|mongo|mongodb|ue-mapper|redis|prometheus|ueransim).*"}[5s]))
